title: Understanding ROC Curves
text: An ROC curve plots the true positive rate (TPR) against the false positive rate (FPR) at various threshold settings. The point marked with an 'X' represents a specific threshold.

title: Interpreting the ROC Curve
text: The closer the point is to the top-left corner, the better the performance of the classification model at that threshold. The point 'X' is near the top of the curve.

title: Threshold and ROC Curve
text: A lower threshold typically results in a higher true positive rate but also a higher false positive rate. Consider where 'X' is located on the curve.

title: Choosing the Threshold
text: Given the position of 'X' on the ROC curve, which threshold value is most likely?
